pages.title: Build repeatedly
pages.text: The Auto Constructor automatically crafts from blueprints in directly adjacent Blueprint Storage. Open $(thing)Ingredients$() to transfer ingredients between your inventory and the machine. Machine slots appear above your inventory; relevant carried ingredients keep their positions, with a separated hotbar. Products appear in the output slots below the main menu.$(br2)Item automation can supply ingredients and collect products too. Connect both flux components and check the redstone mode. The machine cycles through the library, crafting available recipes when ingredients and output room are ready.

pages.title: Keep it supplied
pages.text: Allow $(thing)10 of each flux per tick$(), plus $(thing)100 of each per craft$(). The machine has 18 ingredient slots and six output slots.$(br2)Leave room for the entire recipe batch in an output slot. Supply subcomponents yourself: it will not craft missing parts recursively.$(br2)Use an $(l:ariente:automation/first_field)Automation Field$(/l) to deliver ingredients and carry products away.
